GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.1 (1 Feb 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 690)
APO 500
1 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Governor of Hiroshima.
1. It has been reported to this headquarters that the Governor of Hiroshima received the following telegram from the Vice Minister of Welfare on 4 January 1946.
"A report arrived to the SCAP that you have manifested before the local US Army authorities that you are not responsible for matters concerning repatriation and that neither rice nor fuel are available. Although it is believed that such a statement has not been made, you are directed to reply, to meet with the request for investigation made by SCAP."
2. There is no record of report cited in quoted telegram. No request has been made by this headquarters for investigation of this matter.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will bring the contents of this memorandum to the attention of the Minister of Welfare.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
